items.author: EvaahereAi
items.text: 3/ Object removal Use this when you want to remove something from the video. Prompt: Remove [object to remove] from this video completely. Reconstruct the missing area using realistic background details from the surrounding scene. Keep [main subject], lighting, shadows, camera movement, and overall composition unchanged. Ensure the removal looks natural with no visible editing artifacts. Example: Remove the water bottle from this video completely.Reconstruct the area using the surrounding table texture and background details. Keep the person, lighting, shadows, and camera movement unchanged. Ensure the final result looks clean and realistic.
